project.name: bot-pilot-google-calendar-connector-application
project.description:
Use-case layer: orchestrates calendar operations via the SPI port interfaces.
Contains: - ReadBusyEventsUseCase — delegates to CalendarEventReader port - CreateCalendarEventUseCase — delegates to CalendarEventWriter port - NotAuthenticatedException — thrown when no credentials exist for the context
This module depends ONLY on the calendar SPI (ports + generic model) and the Google connector domain (for CredentialRepository typing in OAuth helpers). There are no Google API imports, no Spring annotations, no JPA here.
No @Service/@Component — use cases are wired as @Bean in the -app assembler. This makes them trivially testable with plain Mockito without a Spring context.
